neighbours.label: the word ' strong' and near-synonyms (' vigorous', ' strongly', ' firmly') as an intensity adjective, as opposed to other adjectives in the same frames
fire: He has strong opinions about the role of schools.
A strong storm hit the coast on Friday.
She is a strong supporter of the new library.
The lawyer made a strong case for the defense.
They are vigorous opponents of the plan.
We drank strong tea and talked.
The mayor strongly disagreed with the report.
quiet: He has old books about the role of schools.
A small boat hit the coast on Friday.
She is a regular visitor of the new library.
The lawyer made a brief trip for the holiday.
They are distant cousins of the mayor.
We drank cold tea and talked.
The mayor briefly spoke to the crowd.

notes: Russian 'но' and Chinese 紧紧 on the card are not tested; they may fit an 'intensity' reading.
